faq.q: Can I make a TikTok ad from one product photo?
faq.a: Yes. Upload one clear picture, describe one product moment, and choose 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds. The credit cost appears before you start.

faq.q: Does this build the ad from my product page link?
faq.a: No. The clip starts from the product photo you upload, not from a product page link. You describe the scene yourself.

faq.q: What does a TikTok clip cost?
faq.a: A clip costs 24, 40, 60 or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds, and the price shows before you start. If a file fails, those credits return on their own.

faq.q: Do I need a TikTok creator, a studio, or a voice track?
faq.a: No creator and no studio. The file does not include music, captions, or narration. Add those in TikTok or your editor after download. If a person appears, that presenter is generated. It is not a customer and not someone you hired.

faq.q: Can AI-made TikTok ads beat a filmed ad?
faq.a: We do not promise a higher result than a filmed ad. What you can do is try another opening from the same photo without booking another shoot.

faq.q: Will this choose my TikTok audience?
faq.a: No. You choose the scene and the length. Targeting and budget stay in TikTok Ads Manager. Check TikTok's current rules for AI content on the day you publish.

faq.q: Can I make a second version from the same photo?
faq.a: Yes. Make another file with a different action or line. Each file shows its own credit cost first.

faq.q: How fast can I get the TikTok file?
faq.a: We do not promise a finish time. The credit cost shows before you start. For the opening, walk through [how to make a TikTok ad](/guides/first-tiktok-video-ad), then check TikTok's ad rules on the day you publish.
